header.subtitle: Generated from {files} indexed source files{truncated} · branch {branch} @ {sha} · last refreshed {when}
header.stale: Index has changed since this tour was generated

readiness.notCloned: This repository has no local clone yet — the tour needs one. Cloning may still be running or may have failed.
readiness.notIndexed: Indexing in progress or not run yet

empty.title: Generate onboarding tour
empty.body: DevDigest reads the repository index and writes a guided tour: architecture, critical paths, how to run, a reading order, and first tasks. Takes up to 2 minutes · one model call.

banner.failure: Regeneration failed: {reason} — showing the tour from {when}

reasons.index_partial: The index is partial: some files could not be parsed or indexing ran out of time.
reasons.index_truncated: The index stopped at the first 5,000 source files; the rest are not ranked.
reasons.unsupported_language: No JavaScript or TypeScript files were indexed — the import graph covers JS/TS only.
reasons.no_import_graph: The index holds no import edges, so critical paths are unavailable.
reasons.no_history: No commit history was available, so files are ranked by the import graph only.
reasons.facts_truncated: Some repository facts were shortened or left out to fit the model's input budget.
reasons.llm_not_configured: No API key is configured for {provider}.
reasons.llm_timeout: The model did not answer within 120 seconds.
reasons.llm_invalid_output: The model's answer did not match the expected structure.

emptyReasons.unsupported_language: No JavaScript or TypeScript files were indexed — the import graph covers JS/TS only.
emptyReasons.no_import_graph: The index holds no import edges, so critical paths are unavailable.
emptyReasons.no_run_facts: No package manifest or compose file was found.
emptyReasons.needs_model: Needs the model — regenerate when the model is available.
emptyReasons.no_valid_tasks: The model proposed no task whose scope exists in the repository.

usage.calls: {count, plural, one {# model call} other {# model calls}}
